### Membrain Pricing FAQ

### How does Membrain pricing work?

**Membrain pricing depends on the products you choose** and the number of users who need access.

Choose from Prospecting, Active Pipeline, Account Growth, and Elevate based on your needs, and expand as your needs grow.

### What’s included in the price?

Your price includes access to the Membrain products you choose, with the tools, guidance, and built-in sales process support your team needs to put your strategy into practice.

We also provide ongoing support to help your team get value from Membrain as your needs evolve.

### Is pricing per user or per team?

**Pricing is primarily per user.** This means you can provide access to the people who need Membrain without having to license your entire organization.

### Can we adjust our plan as we grow?

Yes. Membrain is built for companies committed to growth, which means your setup can evolve. Add users, expand into new products, or refine your approach as your needs change.


### What’s the difference between platform upgrades and product extensions?

**Platform upgrades** apply to all users and unlock broader capabilities across your entire setup.

**Product extensions**, on the other hand, can be added for specific users or teams based on their role, so you only invest where it creates value. This gives you flexibility to grow both company-wide and function-specific over time.

### Is there a minimum commitment or long-term contract?

Membrain is designed for long-term impact, but we keep the commercial model straightforward and transparent.

Specific terms depend on your agreement, but the focus is always on delivering value, not locking you in.

### How do Insight Engine credits work and what actions use credits?

Insight Engine uses a monthly credit system to power AI actions and data enrichment.

Credits are consumed when users perform AI-powered tasks (such as AI Compose, AI Summary, AI Rewrite, Ask AI, or Auto Fill) or when enriching data like adding companies, contacts, emails, or phone numbers.

Smaller AI actions typically cost 1–3 credits, while advanced enrichment actions (like direct dial phone numbers) cost more.

Credits reset monthly based on the selected package, and unused credits do not roll over.

Learn more about Insight Engine [here](https://www.membrain.com/insight-engine?hsLang=en).

## How to Choose the Right Alternative

![Schematic: How to Choose the Right Alternative (Membrain, Budget, Customer relationship management, Integration requirements)](https://www.revenueflow.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fblog%2Fai%2Fbest-membrain-alternatives-2.webp&w=1920&q=75&dpl=dpl_DfweX5XhcBynWBUp7nwxvquWoFjX)

Consider these factors when evaluating your options:

**Budget:** Published entry prices in this roundup range from Free to $299/mo; 1 of the 44 tools quote on request. Make sure the tool you choose fits both your current budget and projected growth.

**Customer relationship management volume:** Match the tool's tier limits to your expected usage. Overpaying for capacity you don't need cuts into ROI.

**Integration requirements:** Check that the alternative connects with your existing CRM, email provider, and automation tools. Migration costs go up when you need to replace workarounds.

**Team workflow:** The best tool on paper is useless if your team doesn't adopt it. Prioritize platforms that fit how your team already works.
